svg.text: MECHANICAL LOCK (§4.3 shank — ratchet barbs + DIN-471 groove)
Anchor retention (BLOCKER-3, HW.26) · mechanical_lock_zone1 · 01_01 §4.3
FRONT
4× barb · shallow α ramp faces the LEFT end (enters PEEK first)
SIDE
NOTES:
1. DIN-471 groove 1.1×0.25 mm at z=15 (§4.3 B); barb base≈0.59 mm (derived h·(cotα+cotβ), §4.3 A)
2. Material: V-free Ti alloy - same body as the Zone-1 gyroid anode (01_02 2.5, founder 2026-06-21): alloy NOT SELECTED until the Stage-2
coin bake-off (00_07 HW.24); Ti-6Al-4V is the price baseline only, NOT the material of this part
3. Process: SLM/DMLS, same build cycle as the Zone-1 gyroid anode (01_01 §3 step 1). Build ORIENTATION NOT SPECIFIED - an open verdict
(00_07 HW.26 G4): the anode's tip-down (01_02 §1.6) puts this shank's free end UP, so the steep barb face (beta 70 deg from the axis)
faces DOWN at 20 deg from horizontal and does NOT self-support; the 60 deg self-supporting downface of 01_01 4.3 A holds only for a lock
printed ramp-down as a separate part. External supports, re-derived alpha/beta and tip-up are each a verdict - do not choose one at the
machine
4. Surface: ETCHED — and that follows from the production ORDER, not from a finish spec. The order INVERTED on 2026-09-17: canon forbids the
bake after the PEEK press-fit (measured — at 250 C the O11 bore grows 180-217 um more than the shaft), and the bake must follow the etch
it degasses, so BOTH surviving branches of 01_02 1.3 etch the BARE printed part and assemble afterwards. This surface is therefore no
longer inside the joint when the anchor is etched. The dual-scale Sa/Sv requirement of 01_02 1.2 is for the gyroid wall and does NOT
apply here. The as-printed finish of the barb faces is NOT SPECIFIED: the Sa about 15 um of 01_01 4.3 A belongs to a 60 deg
self-supporting downface, which this integrated shank does not have at the anode's tip-down - its steep face prints DOWN at 20 deg, and
what that face looks like depends on the open orientation verdict (00_07 HW.26 G4). (The consequence is ours; the ORDER is canon.)
ATTENTION - what ACCEPTANCE applies here is OPEN, and do not read the gyroid band onto it: 01_02 1.2 writes the dual-scale Sa/Sv row for
the catalytic wall, whose duty is surface area, while this is a mating face of an interference fit. The question the inversion OPENED,
and which nothing has measured, is the mirror of the old one: whether an etched surface survives the press-fit at all, and what the etch
takes off the 2t of interference (00_07 HW.34/HW.26). Until that is answered this note states the STATE of the surface, never a
requirement for it.
5. Post-process: HIP (01_02 §1.7); DIN-471 groove — CNC post-DMLS (§4.3 B, +15 min/anchor); NO ring is fitted as a backup (removed
2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.26) - the groove stays only until HW.26 G1/G3 decides whether this end needs a stop against moving deeper
6. Coating: NOT SPECIFIED, and deliberately so: the 01_02 3.6 map has a row for the Zone-1 gyroid wall and a row for the callus-contact
periphery, and this press-fit shank is on NEITHER. Apply nothing without a verdict. The reason is not DET here but FIT: any coating of
thickness t adds 2t of DIAMETRAL interference; 01_01 4.2 gives the nominal CLASS (H7/s6), and the tree's band is 5-34 um diametral from
tools/in_silico/lib/constants.py - which is NOT that class: it is the H7/r6 read (s6 on O11 gives 10-39 um), and no table class is meant:
the band is to be solved from the Lame window (ratified 2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.3; only its inputs are open). ATTENTION on the band's
PROVENANCE, corrected 2026-09-11 (00_07 HW.3): those micrometres are a plain ISO 286 table read (H7 0/+18 + r6 +23/+34 on O11), NOT a
Lame result - Lame CONSUMES the band to compute a contact pressure and does not produce it. This matters because 01_01 4.2 requires the
drawing's micrometres to come from the Lame interference window and explicitly REJECTS a blind ISO 286 lookup, so quoting the band as
Lame-computed dresses the rejected source in the required source's name. Re-deriving it is ratified (2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.3 - floor: the
fit still holds at +40 C; ceiling: PEEK von Mises at -30 C) and waits on its inputs only; at its MIN the 5-34 band lies BELOW that floor,
so the number WILL move - it stays the working input until then
7. Lattice: Not applicable - solid shank, no lattice. (Printed as one body with the Zone-1 gyroid anode, whose lattice spec lives in
cem/anchor_zone1.*.json)
8. Inspect: Barb tooth geometry MEASURED against 01_01 4.3: height h and the DERIVED base (a triangle has two free parameters, so alpha/beta
+ h are specified and base is computed, acceptance 0.40-0.60 mm). DIN-471 groove to the real standard dimensions for this shaft diameter,
CNC after printing. ATTENTION: no ring is fitted as a creep backup (removed 2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.26): under the sleeve's lower end a ring
would only stop the anode moving DEEPER, never pulling out; whether that stop is needed is HW.26 G1/G3. Pull-out retention 3-5x over
friction and the PEEK 150 C click-fit are FEA (00_07 HW.3.IS) + bench - NOT asserted by this generator and NOT a drawing acceptance line
9. Self-contained demo shank (Zone-1 Ø11 real, HW.33) — not yet integrated into the gyroid rod (separate session, 00_07 HW.26)
10. Barb pull-out (3–5× vs friction) and PEEK 150°C click-fit retention are FEA + bench (HW.3.IS), NOT asserted by this generator
